text: OK, this is going to be long, apologies, it's been a very long day. My stepdaughter is 9. She came back from her mum's this afternoon a bit off and tonight her temperature is 37.7, so not massive. She has a rash, and actually I think it's two different things, which is why I'm confused. She's got dark skin so it's quite hard to see anything on her arms or body. I read that you should check paler bits, so I looked at her palms, the soles of her feet and inside her lower eyelids. On her palms and one sole there are some little dark pinprick dots, and when I pressed a glass on them they didn't fade, I could still see them. But there's also a blotchy rash on her chest that I could just about make out, and that one DID go pale when I pressed the glass on it. So one fades and one doesn't? I don't know what to make of that. The other thing is she hasn't really been weeing. I asked her and she said she's barely been since lunch, which isn't like her at all. Her dad's away for work and I'm running on fumes, so I just want to know if I'm worrying over nothing or if this needs looking at tonight.
